name: opendesk
description: OpenDesk by VitalOps — open-source computer-use MCP server that lets AI agents see and control macOS, Windows and Linux desktops, locally or across paired machines.
long_description:
OpenDesk is an open-source computer-use framework from VitalOps (not the openDesk office suite). It gives Claude and other AI agents eyes and hands on a real desktop: screenshots with a Set-of-Marks overlay, accessibility-based UI actions (click buttons by name, no coordinates), mouse and keyboard control, app management, clipboard, OCR, workflow recording and replay, scheduled tasks, a full audit log, and a local, searchable screen memory. Paired remote machines can be driven over an end-to-end encrypted connection. Everything runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

On macOS, grant Accessibility and Screen Recording to Claude Desktop (System Settings → Privacy & Security), then restart it.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the screen or a region, optionally with numbered Set-of-Marks boxes over interactive elements. Read-only.

tools.name: ui
tools.description: Act on UI elements by name through the accessibility API: inspect the tree, click, type, use menus, read values. No coordinates needed.

tools.name: mouse
tools.description: Move, click, double-click, right-click, scroll or drag, with Retina-aware scaling from screenshot coordinates.

tools.name: keyboard
tools.description: Type text (full Unicode), press keys, send hotkeys or hold a key.

tools.name: app
tools.description: Open, close, focus or list desktop applications.

tools.name: clipboard
tools.description: Read or write the clipboard text.

tools.name: ocr
tools.description: Extract visible text from the screen or a region. Read-only.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Record a desktop workflow once and replay it later.

tools.name: schedule
tools.description: Run a task or learned workflow on a timer.

tools.name: audit
tools.description: Show the session audit log and replay recorded sessions.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Search the local screen memory: what was on screen, when, in which app. Read-only; nothing leaves the machine.

tools.name: memory_manage
tools.description: Pause or resume screen-memory capture, edit the per-app deny list, change storage settings or delete history.

tools.name: script
tools.description: Run a script or API call when the task needs no visual interaction.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Drive a web browser through its automation interface.

tools.name: fleet
tools.description: Run a task across several paired machines.

tools.name: opendesk_peers
tools.description: List this machine and the paired remote peers.

tools.name: opendesk_discover
tools.description: Find OpenDesk peers on the local network (mDNS).

tools.name: opendesk_use
tools.description: Set the default machine for subsequent computer-use calls.

tools.name: opendesk_status
tools.description: Show the current default peer and open connections.

tools.name: opendesk_describe
tools.description: Show what a paired peer is for and what it has access to.

tools.name: opendesk_capabilities
tools.description: Show what a peer's backend can do.

tools.name: opendesk_disconnect
tools.description: Close a cached remote connection (the peer stays paired).
